prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Lucía, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Lucía thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially rolling out massive fines for bin violations starting immediately. They are finally cracking down hard, so expect major enforcement on every sidewalk in the neighborhood."
text: The council is launching an aggressive, zero-tolerance crackdown on all sidewalk bins starting today. Expect inspectors to be patrolling every single street to hand out massive, immediate fines to anyone caught in violation.
